benefits: Turns one multi-sheet workbook into separate files without Excel installed.
Tick only the sheets you need; each becomes its own genuine .xlsx file.
Each output keeps its original sheet name inside the workbook.
Everything runs locally, so confidential spreadsheets never leave your device.

faqs.a: Modern .xlsx files only. The old binary .xls format is not supported. Re-save such files as .xlsx first.
The workbook's own sheet names are read and listed with their row counts, so you can pick exactly the sheets you want before splitting.
faqs.q: How do I know which sheets are inside?

faqs.a: Only stored cell values are carried into the parts. Formulas, charts, images and cell formatting are not preserved; formula cells use their last saved values.
Yes. Each output is a single-sheet workbook that keeps the original sheet's name, for example report-Sales.xlsx keeps the sheet Sales.
faqs.q: Does each file keep its sheet name?

faqs.a: They download one after another with a short pause, named workbook-sheetname.xlsx. Your browser may ask permission for multiple downloads.

split-excel-workbook.formula: one .xlsx per selected sheet = genuine single-sheet .xlsx workbook per sheet
howTo: Click Choose file and select an .xlsx workbook from your device.
Wait while the workbook is read and its sheets are listed.
Tick the sheets you want as separate files, or use Select all.
Press Split workbook and download each .xlsx file one by one.
keyFacts: Splits a multi-sheet .xlsx workbook into one file per worksheet.
Each output is a genuine single-sheet .xlsx workbook that opens everywhere.
Sheet names and row counts are listed so you can choose exactly what to extract.
Select all or select none with one click; tick individual sheets freely.

split-excel-workbook.workedExample:
A workbook report.xlsx has 3 sheets:
Sales (11 rows), Staff (6 rows), Notes (3 rows).

You tick Sales and Staff only.
The tool downloads:
report-Sales.xlsx with the Sales sheet (11 rows)
report-Staff.xlsx with the Staff sheet (6 rows)

2 genuine .xlsx files from 2 selected sheets.
